what_worked: Power-law observation and three-step filtering funnel show genuine analytical thinking applied to the dataset.
fix_next: Replace speculative business projections with actual charts, acknowledge missingness rates, and correct fabricated statistics against the real data.
verdict: Polished consulting cosplay with fabricated numbers, no real charts, and heavy AI-generated filler.
factual_error_detail: Slide 1/12: $13.5M monthly revenue vs actual $15.6M total revenue (mislabeled and wrong). Slide 3: median MRR $282 not verifiable as dataset median. Slide 4: AI median $446 vs reference $503; 'DevTools & Analytics' combined median $1,294 is fabricated (Dev Tools median $635, Analytics median $419). Slide 4: '20% of Exchange' — 197/1000 is 19.7% but 274 categories missing so denominator is 726, making AI actually 27.1% of categorized listings. Slide 5: r=0.91 for subscribers vs MRR is unverifiable from the frozen reference and likely fabricated. Slide 6: '70% plateaued or shrinking' is unsupported. Slide 7: '38x median' multiple is unsourced. Slide 12: '262 live listings' contradicts 1,000 listings without explanation.

evidence.insight: Slide 3 power-law framing and slide 10 funnel are genuine analytical contributions; slide 4 AI-vs-DevTools contrast is a useful idea but built on wrong numbers; slides 8-9 and 11 are speculative strategy, not data insight.
evidence.narrative: Coherent arc from market overview through distribution, categories, correlations, valuation mismatches to strategy/roadmap. But the second half (slides 8-11) abandons data analysis for fictional business planning with fabricated financial projections ($1.8M arbitrage, $1.2M ARR, 88% margin).
evidence.framing: Fictional 'CEO Board Briefing' framing obscures the actual analytical task. No mention of 24-29% missingness across country/category/audience_type/domain fields, no scope limitations, no caveats. A cold reader cannot tell this is student data analysis.
evidence.accuracy: At least 8 factual errors: wrong total revenue, wrong AI median, fabricated combined DevTools+Analytics median, wrong denominator for category share, unverifiable r=0.91, unsupported 70% claim, unsourced 38x median, contradictory 262 live listings. Zero acknowledgment of missingness.
evidence.visual: Zero actual data visualizations across 12 slides — no scatter plots, histograms, or bar charts. Slide 5 has a minimal horizontal bar but it displays fabricated correlations. Every slide uses identical card-and-text layout with massive empty space. Status badges on slides 6-7 have rendering/legibility issues. Consistent dark theme but no visual variety or data encoding.
evidence.ai_slop: Pervasive consulting jargon: 'sovereign software asset exchange,' 'capital allocation efficiencies,' 'asymmetric information,' 'institutional-grade deal stream.' Every slide has templated 'WHY THE BOARD SHOULD CARE' footer. Slides 8-9 and 11 contain fabricated financial projections entirely untethered from the dataset. Language is interchangeable with any SaaS marketplace pitch.

change_reason: Lowered narrative 5.5→5.0 because half the deck is speculative strategy not data storytelling; lowered accuracy 3.5→3.0 after confirming 8 errors including fabricated combined median and wrong total revenue label; lowered visual 4→3.5 because there are literally zero data charts across 12 slides; lowered framing 4→3.5 for complete absence of limitations/missingness disclosure.
